# x402 SDK Integration

> This is SameDayDesk's independent integration reference for the open source x402 SDK. SameDayDesk uses x402 in its live pay-per-call MCP gateway and in its payment settlement tooling. This site keeps the operational guidance beside a complete, searchable Sourcey reference for the upstream Go SDK.

## Integration

- [x402 SDK integration reference](/docs/x402-sdk/introduction.html): This is SameDayDesk's independent integration reference for the open source x402 SDK. SameDayDesk uses x402 in its live pay-per-call MCP gateway and in its payment settlement tooling. This site keeps the operational guidance beside a complete, searchable Sourcey reference for the upstream Go SDK.
- [SameDayDesk production map](/docs/x402-sdk/samedaydesk-production.html): The SameDayDesk gateway turns HTTP and MCP tool calls into x402-protected resources. This page maps each production concern to the public SDK component that handles it.
- [Minimal TypeScript seller pattern](/docs/x402-sdk/typescript-seller.html): SameDayDesk's public gateway uses the official x402 TypeScript packages with an Express server. The reduced pattern below shows the same component boundaries without copying product-specific routes or credentials.
- [Go SDK quickstart](/docs/x402-sdk/go-quickstart.html): The Sourcey API tab is generated from the x402 Go v2 module. This short path helps Go users find the right package before drilling into individual symbols.
- [Version and generation scope](/docs/x402-sdk/version-and-scope.html): This site is reproducible and intentionally pinned. It is not a floating scrape of the upstream default branch.

## Go API Reference

- [github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2](/docs/x402-sdk/api/package-root.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2
- [extensions/bazaar](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-bazaar.html): Package bazaar provides the Bazaar Discovery Extension for x402 v2 and v1.
- [extensions/buildercode](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-buildercode.html): Package buildercode provides types and helpers for the Builder Code Extension (ERC-8021).
- [extensions/eip2612gassponsor](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-eip2612gassponsor.html): Package eip2612gassponsor provides types and helpers for the EIP-2612 Gas Sponsoring extension.
- [extensions/erc20approvalgassponsor](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-erc20approvalgassponsor.html): Package erc20approvalgassponsor provides types and helpers for the ERC-20 Approval Gas Sponsoring extension.
- [extensions/paymentidentifier](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-paymentidentifier.html): Package paymentidentifier implements the payment-identifier extension for x402.
- [extensions/signinwithx](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-signinwithx.html): Package signinwithx provides helpers for the sign-in-with-x extension.
- [extensions/types](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-types.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/extensions/types
- [extensions/v1](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-extensions-v1.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/extensions/v1
- [http](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-http.html): THIS FILE IS AUTO-GENERATED - DO NOT EDIT
- [http/echo](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-http-echo.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/http/echo
- [http/gin](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-http-gin.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/http/gin
- [http/nethttp](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-http-nethttp.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/http/nethttp
- [mcp](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mcp.html): Package mcp provides MCP (Model Context Protocol) transport integration for the x402 payment protocol.
- [mechanisms/evm](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mechanisms-evm.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/mechanisms/evm
- [mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mechanisms-evm-batch-settlement.html): Package batched holds shared batch-settlement error constants used across client / facilitator / server.
- [mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement/client](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mechanisms-evm-batch-settlement-client.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement/client
- [mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement/facilitator](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mechanisms-evm-batch-settlement-facilitator.html): Package facilitator emits canonical batch-settlement EVM rejection tokens.
- [mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement/server](/docs/x402-sdk/api/pkg-mechanisms-evm-batch-settlement-server.html): github.com/x402-foundation/x402/go/v2/mechanisms/evm/batch-settlement/server
